title: Men’s College Basketball 2020 Tournament Champion
text: This is a story about who would have won the 2020 Men’s college basketball NCAA tournament.

title: About
text: Hello, my name is Brandon Jurgens. I am a junior Sports Media and Communication major at the Univeristy of Nebraska-Lincoln. I am from Filley, NE and went to high school at Freeman Public Schools. For the first two years of my college education I spent time at Southeast Community College in Lincoln. Sports media is a great major for me as I played sports growing up but knew I wasn’t going to play in college. I have also always loved watching sports no matter how big. Sports media allows me to combine my love of watching sports with my knowledge from playing them and hopefully get a career that I am excited about.
